result.summary: I've recorded Ellis's reply ("Yes please mend it", event 006) as approval 8 and moved the ticket on to finding a contractor. Ellis was asked whether to send one of our contractors, with a quote first if the job turned out to be big, and his reply clearly says yes. Ellis and the tenant have both been sent an update. The ticket is now waiting for the agency to assign a contractor, with a follow-up in 2 days.
result.situation: The tenant reported a problem with the toilet flush in the second bedroom at Flat 10, 130 Lantern Quay. Harriet emailed Ellis (the landlord) on 12 Oct asking whether he wanted one of our contractors to fix it, or quote first if the job was big, or whether he'd rather deal with it himself. Ellis replied "Yes please mend it." An internal note (event 005) asked us to check whether the landlord needed a reply. There was no open hold in the CRM, even though event 004 says the ticket was put on hold.
